create.name: Dr. Jeffrey Thompson
create.bio:
Dr. Jeffrey Thompson trained as a chiropractor and has a fine-arts background in music, and for several decades he has studied the effects of sound, rhythm and vibration on awareness and brainwave states. A composer, sound researcher and teacher, he founded the Center for Neuroacoustic Research, based in Carlsbad, California. His neuroacoustic soundtracks rely on brainwave entrainment, using phase-modulated binaural beats of his own design and three-dimensional sound processing, and he worked on the release of NASA's Voyager space-sound recordings.

Scientific Sounds sells his recordings for relaxation, meditation and creativity, and Sounds True has published several of his audio programmes, among them Brainwave Symphony and Gamma Meditation System. His YouTube channel carries long-form live talks on intuition, consciousness, sacred geometry and the default mode network, as well as Global Mind Link, his group sound sessions. On The Shift Network he teaches quantum acoustics and psychoacoustics.

courses.title: Gamma Meditation 2 Program Set
courses.description: Two neuroacoustic soundtracks designed to accompany meditation using gamma-range brainwave entrainment, inspired by research on long-term meditators.

courses.title: Theta Meditation System 2 Program Set
courses.description: Two soundtracks that use brainwave entrainment to guide the listener towards mid- and deep-theta states for reflective, exploratory meditation.

courses.title: Meditation (Music Bundle)
courses.description: A download-only bundle of about three hours of neuroacoustic soundtracks, arranged as a sequence for deepening stages of meditation and prayer.

courses.title: Sri Yantra
courses.description: A soundscape based on the Sri Yantra, composed as a support for meditation, insight and creative problem-solving.

courses.title: Sonic Labyrinth
courses.description: The labyrinth, a sacred symbol, translated into a soundscape for meditation and inner reflection.
